promises.label: Cut fixed costs $500 million
promises.commitment: Reduce fixed costs by $500 million annually, with the full annualized benefit in 2024.
promises.outcomeSummary: Management confirmed execution of the $500 million cost-out and delivered SG&A leverage; the fiscal 2024 annual report subsequently confirmed the reduction plan was executed.

missing.what_was_said: Management said it had taken the necessary actions to achieve the cost benefit and had accomplished its fixed-cost-reduction objective toward the end of 2023, explaining the $500 million of savings included in its fiscal 2024 guidance. This implementation milestone is omitted from S4.

promises.label: Equip 17 Pro markets
promises.commitment: Equip 17 top Pro markets with fulfillment, assortment, salesforce and digital capabilities by end-2024; trade credit and order management remain in pilot/development.
promises.outcomeSummary: Management reported key Pro capabilities in 17 markets before the deadline; trade credit remained in pilot and order management was progressing, consistent with the original scope.

citations.title: HD – Q2’24 Home Depot Earnings Call EVENT DATE/TIME: August 13, 2024 / 09:00AM ET

missing.what_was_said: Alongside announcing capabilities in 17 markets, management said the trade-credit pilot was underway and order-management enhancements were progressing. This confirms that the delivery announcement did not mean those developing capabilities were complete.

Management cautioned that the 17 markets were at different stages of maturity, with further work on delivery, trade credit, order management, SRS integration and store connectivity. The foundational rollout was delivered, but development of the broader ecosystem continued.

promises.label: Open 40–50 distribution branches annually
promises.outcomeSummary: The annual target remained 40 to 50 new SRS branches. Management reported greenfield openings, but annual delivery was not confirmed in the reviewed disclosures.

citations.title: The Home Depot, Inc.(HD-US), Q3 2025 Earnings Call

missing.what_was_said: Immediately after stating the 40–50 annual branch target, management said SRS/GMS had been running at that pace since Home Depot acquired SRS. This adds a qualitative progress assessment, though not a quantified annual opening total.
Management reported that SRS had opened a number of greenfield locations across its verticals, alongside completing tuck-in acquisitions. No opening count was provided in that statement.

promises.label: Open 15 stores in 2026
promises.commitment: Open approximately 15 new Home Depot stores in fiscal 2026.
promises.outcomeSummary: The fiscal 2026 plan remained approximately 15 new stores. Management reported 2 first-quarter and 3 second-quarter openings; subsequent announcements confirmed individual openings, not annual completion.

missing.what_was_said: Management reported opening 2 new stores during the first quarter, bringing the total store count to 2,361.
Management reported opening 3 new stores during the second quarter, bringing the total store count to 2,364.

promises.label: Resume share repurchases in 2027
promises.commitment: Expect to resume share repurchases once excess cash returns, anticipated in the first half of 2027.
promises.outcomeSummary: Repurchases remained paused as of August 2, 2026; management subsequently reaffirmed an expected return by the end of Q2 2027.
